biography:
Data Center Construction; Critical Facility and Property Services; Director- Project Management for capital construction projects; Real Estate & Workplace Services. 

Leading teams to deliver top quality results through professional, motivated and engaged staff.

Proven experience in critical infrastructure planning, contracts, design, construction and delivery. Seasoned technical expert creating positive working relationships with customers, regulators, partners and contractors -delivering results through collaboration and teamwork.

Data Center focused as Senior Director for Americas region at NTT and prior role as leader of teams in US East/Central/Canada Regions at AWS. Delivered cloud computing scale and speed, beat cost targets by double digits and implemented customer focused quality goals. Personally committed to Safety at every level of construction and operations- through forward looking planning, accurate metrics and accountability. 
 
Project portfolio includes success addressing unique Scale, Regulatory, Schedule, Budget and Infrastructure constraints. Career total Data Center experience exceeds 200 MW computing capacity delivered, plus ~1,000 MW planned. Other technical project leadership experience exceeds $1.4 Billion of Healthcare, Technology, Manufacturing, Lab and Support/Office facilities. 

Broad knowledge of Facility and Project Development cycle- Strategic Planning, Programming, Capital approval, Design, Construction, Quality, Commissioning and Operation. Absolute commitment and proven experience sustaining facility reliability and up-time through project planning and MOP management. 

I strongly believe that Servant Leadership and Emotional Intelligence create positive, respectful working relationships to bring out the best of all team members. Team members do their best and get results when confident that they are respected and supported. Results are delivered with efficient processes and visible performance metrics with clear accountability. Outcomes are sustained with realistic obtainable goals that include recognition and rewards systems that back them up. Corrections and adjustments are made in real time with active staff management and engagement before performance expectations are missed.
